project.name: AG Associates
project.description: AI-driven legal operations and SaaS platform for panel advocates, featuring zero-staff automation, title search and registration, bank panel operations, and white-label SaaS capabilities for the Indian legal services market.

nodes.name: AI Agreement Automation
nodes.summary: AI-powered pipeline for automated rental agreement drafting, quality assurance, and stamp duty validation. Uses a LangGraph agent chain (Aisha intake, Auditor QA, Bouncer validation) with RAG on legal templates and ReportLab PDF generation.

businessRules: Stamp duty must equal 0.3% of total rent across duration within Rs 50 tolerance
Auditor pass/fail threshold set at 85% score
Extract tenant, landlord, rent, address, dates, deposit from raw message
crossDomainInteractions: Provides drafted agreements to NOI pipeline for filing
Uses RAG engine shared with search agent
Generates PDFs delivered via multi-channel intake

nodes.name: NOI Pipeline & Case Management
nodes.summary: End-to-end Notice of Intimation processing pipeline that orchestrates case seeding, document preparation, IGR portal filing via RPA, status tracking, acknowledgment updates, and automated retry. Includes web-based case management dashboard for monitoring active cases.

businessRules: NOI cases progress through seed to prepare to file to verify to acknowledge lifecycle
External IGR portal callback updates case status
Retry logic for failed filings with exponential backoff
crossDomainInteractions: Receives filed NOI documents from RPA government automation domain
Seeds cases from intake partner integration webhooks
Displays case data in admin dashboard and field mobile app

nodes.name: RPA Government Portal Automation
nodes.summary: Playwright-based browser automation for interacting with Indian government portals. Handles GRAS portal challan generation, IGR portal document filing with OTP authentication, and NESL property registration with multi-mode execution.

businessRules: OTP-based authentication via Redis for government portals
NESL supports three execution modes: API, RPA, mock
Filing status verified through portal scraping
crossDomainInteractions: Generates challans for NOI pipeline cases
Files NOI documents on IGR portal on behalf of pipeline
Executes property registration for NESL client module

nodes.name: Field Executive Mobile Operations
nodes.summary: React Native mobile application for field executives with offline-first case management, document capture via camera scanner, GPS-based activity tracking, push notification registration, and an offline mutation queue with exponential backoff sync.

businessRules: Document uploads use TUS resumable protocol for reliability
Offline mutations queued with FIFO drain and retry limit
Status updates applied optimistically with cache patching
crossDomainInteractions: Fetches assigned cases from NOI pipeline case management
Uploads field-collected documents to Supabase storage
Submits case status updates back to the platform

nodes.name: Platform Intake & Admin Operations
nodes.summary: Multi-channel intake system handling case creation via WhatsApp, SMS, voice calls, email, and n8n webhooks. Includes an admin console with workforce management, voice command control, real-time collaboration, task board, file storage, billing, and role-based access control.

businessRules: n8n webhook intake requires API key verification
Voice command tool registry with risk levels
RBAC with wildcard domain.all permission patterns
AI token quota checked and tracked per organization
crossDomainInteractions: Creates cases in NOI pipeline via intake webhooks
Assigns field executives cases for mobile operations
Workforce management includes AI agents from agreement automation

nodes.name: Rental Agreement Drafting
nodes.summary: AI-assisted rental agreement generation pipeline that extracts tenant details from raw messages, retrieves legal templates, drafts PDF agreements, audits quality, and validates stamp duty before multi-channel delivery.

nodes.name: NOI Case Lifecycle
nodes.summary: End-to-end NOI case processing from seeding and intake through document preparation, IGR filing, status verification, acknowledgment update, and automated retry on failure.

nodes.name: Challan Generation
nodes.summary: RPA-based generation of MTR-6 rent challans and NOI loan challans on the GRAS portal using Playwright browser automation with OTP authentication.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Programmatic call from NOI pipeline or admin console

nodes.name: IGR Document Filing
nodes.summary: Automated NOI document filing on the IGR portal via Playwright, handling login, document upload, OTP authentication, and filing status verification.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Called from NOI pipeline prepare step

nodes.name: Property Registration via NESL
nodes.summary: Multi-mode property registration execution through the NESL (National E-Services) system supporting API, RPA, and mock modes with access token management and transaction tracking.

nodes.name: Field Case Management
nodes.summary: Mobile workflows for field executives to view assigned cases, examine case details and documents, update case status with GPS-tagged audit trails, and receive realtime case changes.

nodes.name: Field Document Capture
nodes.summary: Camera-based document scanning and upload flow with offline queue support, case association, and TUS resumable upload protocol for reliability in low-connectivity environments.

nodes.name: Field Activity Tracking
nodes.summary: GPS-based field activity tracking with on-duty toggling, location breadcrumb buffering, batch flushing to server, and today's activity feed display.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Mobile app activity screen with on-duty toggle

nodes.name: Offline Mutation Sync
nodes.summary: Offline-first mutation queue that enqueues status updates and document uploads during connectivity loss, monitors network restore, and drains the queue FIFO with exponential backoff retry.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Automatic on connectivity loss during mutation

nodes.name: Multi-Channel Intake
nodes.summary: Receives incoming case data via WhatsApp webhook, SMS (Twilio), voice calls (Twilio), email ingestion, and n8n workflow triggers, then routes to the appropriate processing pipeline.

nodes.name: Workforce & Voice Control
nodes.summary: Admin console for managing AI agents and human staff with real-time status monitoring, voice command recording and transcription, tool registry execution, skill gap tracking, and task assignment.

nodes.name: Platform Collaboration
nodes.summary: Real-time collaboration features including kanban task board with drag-and-drop, file storage with version history, notification management, and live presence tracking.

nodes.name: Extract Tenant & Property Details
nodes.summary: Aisha AI agent extracts tenant name, landlord name, rent amount, address, dates, deposit, and stamp duty from raw unstructured message using ChatOpenAI LLM with JSON output parsing.

nodes.name: Retrieve Legal Templates via RAG
nodes.summary: Performs pgvector cosine-similarity search on legal_templates table using SentenceTransformer embeddings to find the most relevant template for the agreement type.

nodes.name: Draft Agreement & Generate PDF
nodes.summary: Builds the agreement document using AgreementPDFGenerator with ReportLab, converting markdown content to formatted PDF with custom styles and structured layout.

nodes.name: Audit Draft Quality
nodes.summary: Auditor agent compares drafted document against extracted JSON via LLM, producing a pass/fail score with threshold of 85 and detailed issue list with feedback.

nodes.name: Validate Stamp Duty
nodes.summary: Bouncer agent computes expected stamp duty at 0.3% of rent multiplied by months, compares to paid amount within Rs 50 tolerance, and records pass or fail.

nodes.name: Deliver Agreement via Channel
nodes.summary: Returns the generated PDF and agreement details through the originating channel: chat API response, WhatsApp reply, SMS, or voice call as appropriate.

nodes.name: Seed NOI Case
nodes.summary: Creates a new NOI case record in the pipeline via the noi_seed API endpoint, setting initial status and storing case metadata.

nodes.name: Prepare Documents for Filing
nodes.summary: Prepares the required NOI documents using the template manager and readies them for submission to the IGR portal.

nodes.name: File on IGR Portal
nodes.summary: Triggers IgrRpaExecutor to file NOI documents on the IGR portal via automated browser session with OTP verification.

nodes.name: Check Filing Status
nodes.summary: Queries current NOI case status via API or awaits external IGR portal callback via noi_webhook to update the case record.

nodes.name: Update Acknowledgment
nodes.summary: Records the final acknowledgment reference and closes the NOI case loop, updating all downstream dashboards and notifications.

nodes.name: Authenticate to GRAS Portal
nodes.summary: Launches Playwright browser, navigates to GRAS portal, and performs OTP-based authentication using Redis for OTP storage.

nodes.name: Navigate Challan Form
nodes.summary: Navigates to the MTR-6 rent challan or NOI loan challan form section within the GRAS portal.

nodes.name: Generate Challan
nodes.summary: Fills challan form fields and submits on the GRAS portal to generate the payment challan.

nodes.name: Download Challan PDF
nodes.summary: Downloads the generated challan PDF from the GRAS portal and stores it for record-keeping and downstream processing.

nodes.name: Login to IGR Portal
nodes.summary: Launches Playwright browser and performs authenticated login to the IGR (Inspector General of Registration) portal.

nodes.name: Upload NOI Documents
nodes.summary: Uploads the prepared NOI documents to the IGR portal through the browser automation session.

nodes.name: Verify OTP for Filing
nodes.summary: Handles OTP verification step required by the IGR portal to authorize the document filing submission.

nodes.name: Confirm Filing Status
nodes.summary: Confirms the filing result from the IGR portal and stores the filing reference and status for downstream case tracking.

nodes.name: Acquire NESL Access Token
nodes.summary: Obtains an access token from the NESL system for authenticating subsequent property registration API calls.

nodes.name: Execute Registration Transaction
nodes.summary: Submits the property registration transaction to NESL via API, RPA, or mock mode depending on configuration.

nodes.name: Generate Filing Reference
nodes.summary: Receives and stores the transaction ID and filing reference returned by the NESL system upon successful registration.

nodes.name: Authenticate & Load Cases
nodes.summary: Handles magic link email authentication and loads assigned cases for the authenticated field executive using React Query with Supabase.

nodes.name: View Case Details & Documents
nodes.summary: Displays full case detail including bank name, case type, status badge, assignment timestamp, and associated documents list.

nodes.name: Update Case Status
nodes.summary: Selects new status from status board grid and applies update with optimistic cache patching and audit log entry including GPS coordinates.

nodes.name: Receive Realtime Case Updates
nodes.summary: Subscribes to Supabase real-time postgres changes for live case updates and auto-invalidates the React Query cache.

nodes.name: Manage Account Settings
nodes.summary: Displays user email and provides sign-out functionality from the settings screen.

nodes.name: Open Scanner & Select Case
nodes.summary: Opens camera scanner interface and allows the field executive to select which case to associate the captured document with.

nodes.name: Capture Photo
nodes.summary: Requests camera permissions, captures a photo using the device camera, and persists the file locally for upload processing.

nodes.name: Upload via TUS Protocol
nodes.summary: Performs TUS resumable PUT upload from local file URI to Supabase Storage with retry delays and chunked transfer for reliability.

nodes.name: Enqueue for Offline Resilience
nodes.summary: Enqueues the upload mutation into the offline queue when connectivity is unavailable, ensuring eventual consistency.

nodes.name: Toggle On-Duty State
nodes.summary: Toggles the field executive on-duty state which starts or stops GPS tracking and activity logging.

nodes.name: Subscribe to GPS Location
nodes.summary: Subscribes to GPS location updates at balanced accuracy and buffers breadcrumb points for batch flushing to the server.

nodes.name: Flush GPS Breadcrumbs
nodes.summary: Batch-inserts field activity log rows (GPS breadcrumbs) to Supabase, silently ignoring unique violations for idempotent retry.

nodes.name: View Today Activity Feed
nodes.summary: Displays today's field activity feed with a route map showing breadcrumb trail from geolocation checkpoints.

nodes.name: Enqueue Mutation Offline
nodes.summary: Captures mutations (status updates, document uploads) when connectivity is lost and stores them in an ordered FIFO queue.

nodes.name: Monitor Connectivity Restore
nodes.summary: Tracks online or offline state via NetInfo event listener and triggers queue drain on connectivity restore.

nodes.name: Drain Queue with Retry
nodes.summary: Processes the mutation queue FIFO with exponential backoff, retry limit enforcement, and bail-out on hard failures.

nodes.name: Receive Webhook Payload
nodes.summary: FastAPI endpoint receives incoming webhook payload from WhatsApp, SMS (Twilio), voice call (Twilio), email, or n8n workflow trigger.

nodes.name: Verify Intake Authentication
nodes.summary: Validates the n8n webhook API key using constant-time comparison or verifies Twilio request signature for authorized intake.

nodes.name: Route to Handler
nodes.summary: Routes the message to the appropriate handler: Aisha AI for agreements, NOI pipeline for case creation, or SMS command parser.

nodes.name: Create Case Record
nodes.summary: Inserts a new case record into the Supabase cases table, resolving bank partner name to organization ID and returning the created row.

nodes.name: Return Acknowledgment
nodes.summary: Returns an appropriate acknowledgment: TwiML response for voice calls, text reply for SMS, or webhook response with case reference ID.

nodes.name: Record & Transcribe Voice Command
nodes.summary: Records audio from the browser, sends for transcription via API, and displays the recognized command text for user confirmation.

nodes.name: Match Command to Tool Registry
nodes.summary: Matches the transcribed command against the voice tool registry with configured risk levels and per-tool enablement settings.

nodes.name: Execute Tool Action
nodes.summary: Executes the voice command tool action with appropriate risk-level handling and logs the command execution for audit.

nodes.name: Monitor Agent & Staff Status
nodes.summary: Displays AI agent and human staff status matrix with real-time updates, load scores, and skill gap indicators.

nodes.name: Assign Tasks to Staff or AI
nodes.summary: Assigns tasks to workforce members (human or AI agents) with priority, tracking, and output storage.

nodes.name: Manage Tasks on Kanban Board
nodes.summary: Kanban-style task board with column-based status grouping, inline task creation, and drag-and-drop reordering with positional tracking.

nodes.name: Share Files with Version History
nodes.summary: Drag-and-drop file upload with progress tracking, TUS resumable protocol, virus scan, versioning, and signed URL generation for secure access.

nodes.name: Send & Receive Notifications
nodes.summary: Manages user notifications with real-time updates, read status tracking, type classification, deep-link support, and push notification dispatch.

nodes.name: Track Realtime Presence
nodes.summary: Tracks online users via Supabase presence channels with user deduplication and displays live activity feed from postgres changes.

edges.description: NOI pipeline triggers IGR document filing and challan generation via RPA executors
Case data from NOI pipeline is assigned to field executives for mobile field operations
Intake webhooks create and seed NOI cases; admin dashboard monitors pipeline
Generated rental agreements may feed into NOI filing pipeline
Admin assigns cases to field executives; push notifications alert mobile users
